title: No real secret is present in the caged environment
adversary_attempt: A step tries to read a credential (API token, refresh token, DB password) from the process environment to authenticate against a real provider.

hermetic_env_fixture.note: A controlled env map the hermetic check scans deterministically. Contains only benign non-secret keys; NO secret-shaped name and NO real value.

hermetic_check: Runs SAFE. Scans the controlled hermetic_env_fixture map (never printing any value) and asserts none of secret_shaped_names is present. Also performs a read-only, value-free advisory scan of the real process.env (reports only NAMES that match, never values) — advisory, so it never fails CI on a founder machine that legitimately holds a secret.

privileged_mechanical_check.what: Boot the real caged runtime under its intended no-secret provisioning and confirm the secret store / keychain / env is genuinely empty of provider credentials at process start.
privileged_mechanical_check.must_not_run_here: Reading a real secret store or keychain is forbidden in this lane.

truth_note: A clean hermetic env map is NOT proof the live caged runtime starts with no secrets. Only an independently-verified privileged boot proves that.
